title: Zephyrine and the Autopsy
author: August Thornbury
blurb: Ada Marchetti, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
